title: Driver Intelligence & AMD Compatibility
headline: A new premium Driver Intelligence hub brings animated hardware scanning and health scoring. AMD users also get dramatically improved hardware data — BIOS, GPU, and motherboard info now load correctly.
changes: New: Driver Intelligence page (premium) — animated SVG motherboard centerpiece, multi-step scan flow, health score radial with subscores, and per-component cards with a sliding detail panel.
New: Driver Intelligence integrates the AI Advisor — hardware-aware insights appear in scan results with a direct link for deeper analysis.
New: Custom slider tweaks — three system-level tweaks now use stepped sliders with precise configurable value ranges instead of simple toggles.
New: First-run disclaimer — a two-phase confirmation modal introduces SwitchControl to new users before any tweaks are applied.
New: Apply Recommended premium gate — free users see an animated amber lock badge on the Apply Recommended button that opens the upgrade flow on click.

Fixed: AMD/WMI hardware probes now use 3–4× longer timeouts — baseboard, BIOS, graphics, CPU, memory layout, and disk probes all have extended limits so AMD Ryzen systems correctly report hardware data.
Fixed: Probe cooldown reduced from 12 minutes to 2 minutes — hardware data recovers within a single restart instead of being blocked for an entire session.
Improved: A single WMI timeout no longer triggers a probe cooldown — two consecutive failures are now required, preventing a transient slowdown from blocking all hardware reads.
